description: Agent Access: submit an API inventory: every endpoint or operation with what it can do (read, create, update, delete, admin, move money, personal data, send, execute or export), the most sensitive data it handles, whether agents can call it as a tool and how it became one (curated, generated from an API description, passed through by a gateway or inherited), and the decision on exposing it with its outcome, its named decider and its date. The signed report names every endpoint that can delete, administer, move money or reach personal or confidential data and is exposed to agents with no recorded decision, exposed by generation or passthrough alone, exposed by a decision that names no decider, or exposed although its decision withholds it, with the fix for each. Spending caps are wever_exposure-cap-check, an agent’s access against its authority is wever_authority-scope-check and a client’s MCP configuration is wever_mcp-server-check. Verdict undecided_exposure, decision_gaps, exposure_unverified or decided_exposure. POST /api/tool-exposure-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-access-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-access/.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint or operation of the API, exposed to agents or not.

decided_by.description: The named person or role who decided.

exposed.description: Agents can call it as a tool.

sensitivity.description: The most sensitive data it handles.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
